title: Hope Diamond Mailed To Museum: Harry Winston posts $1 million gem; plain parcel reshapes its legacy
summary_full: The Hope Diamond embarked on a remarkable journey in 1958 when it was sent as registered mail to the Smithsonian Institution for safekeeping. This precious gem, with its origins in India, has a captivating royal history. American jeweller Harry Winston generously donated it to the museum after obtaining it from Evalyn Walsh McLean's estate in 1949.
